title: chore(render): escape cell text
body:
## Summary
Return html.escape(text) from cell() in src/render.py and add tests/test_render.py asserting that '<b>' becomes '<b>'.

## Rationale
Cell text is inserted into HTML tables, where unescaped angle brackets alter the markup.

## Testing
Validation plan: run tests/test_render.py for the angle-bracket case.

## Limitations
Only cell() is changed; other renderers and already-escaped input are not addressed.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/render.py b/src/render.py
--- a/src/render.py
+++ b/src/render.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
+import html
+
+
 def cell(text):
-    return text
+    return html.escape(text)

diff --git a/tests/test_render.py b/tests/test_render.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_render.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from src.render import cell
+
+
+def test_cell():
+    assert cell('<b>') == '<b>'
